/-- OR-ing a value `b < 2^8` shifted by `n` (with `n + 8 ≤ 64`, truncated mod `2^64`) into an
accumulator `acc < 2^n` is the same as adding `2^n * b`. Used for byte-packing loops. -/
theorem Nat.or_shiftLeft_mod_eq_add {acc b n : ℕ} (hacc : acc < 2 ^ n) (hb : b < 2 ^ 8)
    (hn : n + 8 ≤ 64) : acc ||| (b <<< n % 2 ^ 64) = acc + 2 ^ n * b := by
  have hlt : b * 2 ^ n < 2 ^ 64 := by
    calc b * 2 ^ n < 2 ^ 8 * 2 ^ n := Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hb (Nat.two_pow_pos n)
      _ = 2 ^ (8 + n) := (Nat.pow_add 2 8 n).symm
      _ ≤ 2 ^ 64 := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide) (by omega)
  rw [Nat.shiftLeft_eq, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hlt, Nat.or_comm, Nat.mul_comm,
    ← Nat.two_pow_add_eq_or_of_lt hacc]
  omega

theorem Nat.add_two_pow_mul_lt {acc b n : ℕ} (hacc : acc < 2 ^ n) (hb : b < 2 ^ 8) :
    acc + 2 ^ n * b < 2 ^ (n + 8) := by
  have : 2 ^ n * b ≤ 2 ^ n * (2 ^ 8 - 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (by omega)
  rw [Nat.pow_add]
  have h2 : 2 ^ n * (2 ^ 8 - 1) + 2 ^ n = 2 ^ n * 2 ^ 8 := by
    rw [Nat.mul_sub, Nat.mul_one]; have : 2 ^ n ≤ 2 ^ n * 2 ^ 8 := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ (by decide); omega

and masking to 52 bits yields `a / 2^k + 2^m * (b % 2^(52 - m))`. -/

    (hm : m ≤ 52) :

  have hlo : a / 2 ^ k < 2 ^ m := by

/-- `m x y` computes the full 128-bit product of two `u64` values; it never overflows. -/
@[progress]
theorem m_spec (x y : U64) :
    m x y ⦃ r => r.val = x.val * y.val ⦄ := by
  unfold m
  have hx := x.hBounds
  have hy := y.hBounds
  progress as ⟨ a, ha ⟩
  progress as ⟨ b, hb ⟩
  progress as ⟨ c, hc ⟩
  simp only [ha, hb, UScalar.cast_val_eq, UScalarTy.numBits] at *
  have : x.val * y.val < 2 ^ 64 * 2 ^ 64 := Nat.mul_lt_mul'' hx hy
  have hx2 : x.val % 2 ^ 128 = x.val := Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)
  have hy2 : y.val % 2 ^ 128 = y.val := Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)
  simp only [hx2, hy2] at *
  scalar_tac

/-- The limbs of `L` as natural numbers. -/
theorem L_limbs :
    L[0]!.val = 671914833335277 ∧ L[1]!.val = 3916664325105025 ∧
    L[2]!.val = 1367801 ∧ L[3]!.val = 0 ∧
    L[4]!.val = 17592186044416 := by
  simp only [Array.getElem!_Nat_eq, L_val]
  decide

/-- All limbs of `L` are bounded by `2^52`. -/
theorem L_bounds : ∀ i < 5, L[i]!.val < 2 ^ 52 := by
  obtain ⟨h0, h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := L_limbs
  intro i hi
  interval_cases i <;> simp only [h0, h1, h2, h3, h4] <;> norm_num

/-- `L` represents the group order `ℓ = 2^252 + 27742317777372353535851937790883648493`. -/
@[simp]
theorem L_spec : Scalar52_as_Nat L = _root_.L := by
  obtain ⟨h0, h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := L_limbs
  unfold Scalar52_as_Nat
  simp only [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero, h0, h1, h2, h3, h4]
  unfold _root_.L
  rfl

end curve25519_dalek.backend.serial.u64.constants

namespace curve25519_dalek.backend.serial.u64.constants

/-- The value of `LFACTOR`. -/
@[simp]
theorem LFACTOR_val : LFACTOR.val = 1439961107955227 := by
  unfold LFACTOR
  rfl

/-- `LFACTOR` fits in 52 bits. -/
theorem LFACTOR_bound : LFACTOR.val < 2 ^ 52 := by
  rw [LFACTOR_val]; norm_num

/-- `LFACTOR = -L⁻¹ mod 2^52`, stated on the low limb `L[0]`. -/
theorem LFACTOR_spec : (L[0]!.val * LFACTOR.val + 1) % 2 ^ 52 = 0 := by
  rw [L_limbs.1, LFACTOR_val]
